reviews.title: THE WORST sports app on Apple TV
reviews.text:
This app is utter garbage. It freezes constantly, and even on the rare occasions that it doesn’t, everything is extremely clunky and slow to load. Multi-view, in particular, is all but useless; it gets stuck on the game-selection screen, and pressing play/pause (to try and get back to “full-screen”) does nothing. So, even on the rare occasion that it manages to load up two or more games, you are then stuck with the huge game-selection bar at the bottom, taking up at least a third of the screen. It’s completely unwatchable that way.

Luckily, at least I got a free league-pass subscription and thus didn’t waste any money on this trash, but even for free, it’s not worth the headache and wasted time. This is simply sad and embarrassing.

(By the way, my Apple TV is hooked up via ethernet and connectivity is definitely NOT to blame for these issues — every other streaming-app besides NBA works fine.)

reviews.title: Shaqtin a Fool - EDIT
reviews.text:
I gave this a 1 star review five years ago and not much has changed. 

I live in the UK and am waking up early to watch the Finals games before work but the video quality is so appalling it’s impossible to do so. 

It works for a second, then quality drops to a level that you can’t tell what’s happening and then buffers to a point of stopping entirely. And this happens on every possession. It took me 15 painful minutes to watch one minute of game play. 

I tested YouTube, Netflix and Amazon to ensure it wasn’t my WiFi but all were fine. I tried the NBA app using my 5G on my phone, also trash. 

I love the NBA and go to games whenever I visit the US but the quality of this app will never help to grow the sport abroad if it remains this unreliable with the biggest games of the year. PLEASE SORT IT OUT
